notes.title: Update: some balancing and new hit indicator
notes.notes:
Hello! We've just updated Queendoom with a small new feature: a hit indicator will now tell the exact point where the arrow hits when you hit an enemy. We've also made the game a bit easier, given that we were seeing it was too hard for the most part of the players.

Thanks for playing!
